name: ondas
description: Onda Radio: radio del mundo con feed tipo swipe.
author: Mario David Vasco Villareal <contacto@mariovasco.me>

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/clean.mjs build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "build-test/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
